Red Books Day commemorates the publication of the Communist Manifesto on February 21, 1848. It was created by the International Union of Left Publishers of which International Publishers is a member. The organization calls for writers, editors, publishers, booksellers, and readers to read the he Communist Manifesto or another "red" book. The website contains a toolkit on how to host an event, a young socialist art exhibition illustrating the Communist Manifesto, and international event listings.
